# source => result, or error:diagnostic
let flags = (1 << 4) | (1 << 2); (flags >> 2) & 1 => 1
4 >> 1 => 2
8 >> 0 => 8
1 << 3 >> 2 => 2
8 >> 1 >> 1 => 2
8 >> 1 + 1 => 2
8 + 1 >> 1 => 4
8 >> 2 & 3 => 2
8 >> 2 == 2 => 1
1 < 8 >> 1 => 1
fn bit(n) { (0b10100 >> n) & 1 }; bit(2) => 1
match 3 { 3 => 8 >> 1, _ => 0 } => 4
if 0b1010 >> 1 == 5 { 7 } else { 0 } => 7
0 && 1 >> (1 / 0) => 0
1 || -1 >> 999 => 1
0 && 1 >> => error:expected integer
8 >> => error:expected integer
[8] >> 1 => error:expected integer
8 >> [1] => error:expected integer
-1 >> 1 => error:integer overflow
8 >> -1 => error:integer overflow
8 >> 1 / 0 => error:division by zero
